description_expanded: Overview5.0(6 reviews)INLET BEACH – The Good Life 30A Resort-Style Pools & Golf Cart | Steps to The Big Chill | Sleeps 5 DESCRIPTION The Good Life is a stylish 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom townhouse nestled in the heart of Prominence on 30A. Perfectly designed for couples or small families, this modern retreat comfortably sleeps up to five guests. Enjoy easy access to local attractions, live music, dining, and the pristine beaches of Deer Lake State Park. With open-concept living spaces, a fully equipped kitchen, and thoughtfully appointed bedrooms, this townhouse offers both comfort and convenience for an unforgettable stay. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Relax at one of two resort-style community pools, including a seasonally heated North Pool, or head to the beach with your 4-seat gas golf cart, wagon, chairs, and umbrellas. The townhouse has a serene forest view while being just steps from The Big Chill for entertainment, shopping, and dining. HOME FEATURES 2 bedrooms | 2 bathrooms | Sleeps 5 King bed in master | Queen bed in guest bedroom | Pack-n-Play available 3 Smart TVs with YouTube TV (65" in family room, 55" in bedrooms) Fully equipped kitchen with slab granite counters, gas stove, stainless steel appliances, Keurig & standard coffee makers, icemaker, and smoothie maker Bar seating and dining table for 5 Outdoor patio table Wagon, 4 chairs, 2 umbrellas, and golf cart included Forest view at the end of a cul-de-sac Access to seasonal shuttle DINING & ENTERTAINMENT Steps from The Big Chill for live music, sports, shopping, and dining Community Pools WHY STAY HERE? Perfect for couples or small families Resort-style amenities with private touches Easy access to beaches and local attractions SLEEPING ACCOMMODATIONS 1 King bedroom 1 Queen bedroom The Good Life combines style, convenience, and relaxation in the heart of Prominence on 30, your perfect escape for a beachside getaway.Show less
